svg.title: Keypoint R-CNN 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何表示輸入與會交出什麼候選；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 比輸入表示與候選輸出

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 分類、分割與姿態方法可能讀同一張影像，卻把它轉成不同層級的 class、mask 或座標候選。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-must-show: Keypoint R-CNN：依據：known instance boxes/classes、固定 K/order/visibility/symmetry labels、RPN/ROIAlign feature | candidate output: 可用輸出：per-instance ordered keypoints；proposal miss 限制後續 recall，peak 不等於 uncertainty | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: Keypoint R-CNN output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: Keypoint R-CNN：依據：known instance boxes/classes、固定 K/order/visibility/symmetry labels、RPN/ROIAlign feature

g.data-semantic-relation: pass observed points to a declared geometric solver
g.data-must-show: Pose Pipeline：依據：keypoint schema/association、camera/fixture、top-down or bottom-up path 與 geometry solver contract | candidate output: 可用輸出：2D/3D pose/transform 加 uncertainty/fallback；不是單一 heatmap peak | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: Pose Pipeline output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: Pose Pipeline：依據：keypoint schema/association、camera/fixture、top-down or bottom-up path 與 geometry solver contract
